title: Most Valuable NFL Teams 2026: From Cowboys to Bengals

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Most Valuable NFL Teams 2026: From Cowboys to Bengals
sources.description: The average NFL team is worth $9.34 billion, according to data compiled by Sportico for the 2026 NFL team valuations. The Dallas Cowboys rank first at $15.5 billion, while the Cincinnati Bengals rank last at $7.4 billion.
